summary:
To achieve a specialist position in a wide gamut of HR & IR activities and work as part of team to plan coordinate, implement OD intervention to build and sustain a performance culture, create and maintain a work environment that facilitates optimal productivity, morale and employees continuous learning with in organization with a focus on business goal and thus play a challenging and creative role with commitment to organization excellence.
Career Summary
22 years of experience in the field of HR & IR in different industries.Experienced in manpower planning, recruitment, developing performance management system, developing employee welfare programs, identifying training needs and conducting trainings, employee grievance handling, developing and implementing disciplinary policies, conducting exit interview, final settlement of employees. Signed Four Long Term Settlements, CSR activities. General Administration.
